steps.t: Squarespace: Domains, byanymeanssanjose.com, DNS settings
Add TXT record. Host: resend._domainkey. Value: the long DKIM key (copy button)
Add MX record. Host: send. Priority: 10. Value: feedback-smtp.us-east-1.amazonses.com
Add TXT record. Host: send. Value: v=spf1 include:amazonses.com ~all
Tell me 'records added'. I trigger verification and set SJ's email domain from here, you are done

steps.t: MON: find the IRS CP 575 for FullControl, save as PDF. If lost, phone the IRS for a 147C and tell me immediately
MON: transcribe 4 fields exactly: legal name (no abbreviations, no DBA), EIN as 00-0000000, business type, registered address
MON: check the EIN issue date, top-right of the letter
MON: create a rep email on the FullControl domain (gmail and info@ fail)
MON: rep details: real name, title, position, phone as +1XXXXXXXXXX
MON-WED: FullControl site live: custom domain, legal name AND logo visible, not parked. The real long pole
THU: create the Twilio account, upgrade off trial, add billing
THU: submit with the CP 575 open on screen. ISV/Reseller/Partner, vertical EDUCATION, address via autocomplete
SAT: read the result. Approved = send me the SIDs
Only if rejected: file the $10 appeal with the CP 575 PDF, 5-7 business days

humanTasks.title: GHL tokens: fix the FC2 app
humanTasks.why: SJ launches on GHL texting, and it currently survives on a single-use refresh token: one lost response kills it with no recovery. That exact failure took out 14 other academies. This fix removes the single point of failure.

steps.t: Uninstall FC2 first (dots menu). GHL locks the settings while installed
Set distribution to Agency AND Sub-Account
Add the mint scopes: oauth.write + oauth.readonly, plus contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars, locations, users, custom fields, tags
Remove the junk scopes: adPublishing, saas, snapshots, twilioaccount, phone numbers
Confirm redirect includes portal.byanymeansbusiness.com/api/agency-connect, save
Run the install link, pick the AGENCY on the consent screen, expect a pass/fail table
Open /api/agency-connect: should read Healthy, Company token
